script: (() => { const g = window.__ns.game; const c = g.starterCar; const d = c.doorPoint(1); g.player.pos.set(d.x + 1, g.player.pos.y, d.z); g.simulate(0.2); return g.simulate(2.5, [], ['KeyF']); })()
(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.simulate(2, ['KeyW','KeyD']); return g.simulate(2, ['KeyW']); })()
